_about: BLDR brand genome: the machine-readable source for how BLDR describes itself. Facts carry their source; status 'framed' means shown with a label.

changelog.change: Category led by 'AI operating system and factory'. Use cases by function (procurement, sales, marketing, HR, finance, customer service, IT, legal) and industry. Sample uptime 99.99%. 'How to start' replaces 'How to buy'.

Product described as three layers: assistants out of the box, customised with your knowledge, and custom agents for your systems. Procurement is one use case, not the description. Hosted option added. Trust badges shown as a full band.
First BLDR genome, with the approved story block. Site rebuilt as an enterprise one-pager; no-code positioning retired.

brand.name: BLDR
brand.tagline: The AI operating system and factory
brand.promise: Your AI. Your house. Your rules.
brand.one_line: BLDR is the enterprise AI platform that gives you ready-made assistants on day one and custom agents built for your systems, all governed in one place and running where you decide.

positioning: For governments and large enterprises that can't send their data to someone else's servers, BLDR is one governed platform for ready-made assistants and custom agents, built for the systems they already run and deployed where they decide.

pillars.Local: Runs where you decide: on-prem, private cloud or in-country.
pillars.Sovereign: Your data, your models, your keys. No landlord.
pillars.Governed: Every agent action approved, logged and auditable.
pillars.Connected: One layer across SAP, local ERPs and procurement suites, not one AI per vendor.

hero.name: The Builder
hero.is: The organisation that owns its AI, embodied by the champion who brings AI home and gets it into production.

villain.name: The Landlord
villain.is: The AI Overlords as one faceless figure: the small group of frontier AI companies that rent intelligence by the token, on their servers, under their terms.
villain.rule: A category, never a named company, on BLDR and Inova surfaces.

story.twist: The model is a commodity. Ownership is the moat.
arc: Your AI answers to someone else.
The AI Overlords rent you intelligence on their servers, under their rules.
That's why pilots stall, bills grow and data won't reach the model.
Own it instead: local, sovereign, governed, across every system you run.
BLDR is the factory that builds it.

facts.claim: An enterprise deployment across SAP Ariba, SAP ERP and an on-prem ERP is underway in Saudi Arabia
Five agent patterns: document checks with OCR, Arabic-to-English master data, vendor scoring and bid-manipulation detection, tender knowledge search, invoice support
Connectors to SAP Ariba (SLP and Sourcing), SAP ERP over RFC and an on-prem ERP over SQL
ISO 27001 alignment, SOC 2 Ready, GDPR privacy-aware, Privacy Act (AU), PDPL and NCA alignment, Sovereign-Ready
facts.label: Alignment and readiness, not certification

facts.claim: 71% of executives say switching their primary AI vendor or model would be difficult

facts.claim: An average of six AI-related disruptions in two years, mostly vendor services
facts.source: IBM Institute for Business Value, June 2026

facts.claim: 79% of finance leaders had AI cost overruns in the last 12 months
facts.source: DoiT survey by Sapio Research, Feb 2026

voice.register: Firm, sharp, grounded. One sharp line, then the mechanism and the numbers.
rules: We for BLDR, you for the reader
Every number from the facts, with its source
banned: certified or compliant before an audit

visual.signal: lime #CFF53E, navy text only, main action and highlights
visual.dark_moments: One per page: the Overlords statement band

product.short: BLDR comes with assistants out of the box: chat, voice and custom assistants. You make them yours by connecting your own knowledge. When the work needs more than an assistant, custom agents are built for you inside your systems, with model orchestration, approvals and a full audit trail. Everything runs on one governed platform, hosted or in your own infrastructure.

layers.name: Assistants, out of the box
layers.what: Chat, voice and custom assistants, ready to switch on

layers.name: Your knowledge
layers.what: Each assistant customised with the client's own RAG, answering with citations

layers.name: Custom agents
layers.what: Built for one organisation, integrated into its systems, with model orchestration and governance

product.assistant_vs_agent: Assistants answer and help. Agents do work inside systems and wait for approval.
product.any_agent: If the work runs through your systems, an agent for it can be built on BLDR.
product.systems_line: Built for the systems you already run.
